What if you ate only fruit for a month?
Some fruit only diets went viral online as a way to detox. Sounds super healthy, right? Fruit is full of vitamins, fiber and water.

But here's the twist. You'd miss protein and key nutrients like vitamin B twelve, and all that natural sugar can be rough on your teeth. Steve Jobs famously tried fruit diets too! Doctors say a balanced plate with fruit, veggies and protein works much better.
